name: What steps are involved in professional molding installation?

mainEntity.name: What steps are involved in professional molding installation?

acceptedAnswer.text: The process starts with measuring the space, removing old trim if needed, and prepping wall surfaces. Carpenters make precision miter cuts, coped joints, and scarf joints so profiles align cleanly along walls and inside/outside corners. Pieces are secured into wall framing or studs using finish nails. After fastening, the crew fills nail holes, caulks joints along drywall edges, and sands patches smooth before applying final interior paint or stain. Ensuring drywall flaws are corrected prior to fastening keeps trim lines straight.
acceptedAnswer.description: The process involves measuring, cutting precise mitered or coped joints, fastening trim into wall studs, filling nail holes, caulking joints, and applying final paint or stain.
